evals.prompt: I have a Word document with an article about our new caching library written by Marco Rossi. Please create a daenet TechTalk PDF article from it. The cover image is the daenet TechTalk AI cover I sent earlier. Save it to my project folder. The affiliation is DAENET GmbH, Frankfurt.
evals.expected_output: A two-column daenet TechTalk branded PDF with full-bleed cover, header zone, running headers/footers with page numbers, and body text in two columns.

assertions.name: pdf-file-created
assertions.description: A .pdf file exists in the output directory

assertions.name: two-pages-minimum
assertions.description: The PDF has at least 2 pages (cover + content)

assertions.name: title-in-pdf
assertions.description: The article title appears in the PDF text

assertions.name: author-in-pdf
assertions.description: The author name appears in the PDF

assertions.name: daenet-branding
assertions.description: The PDF contains daenet brand text (daenet TechTalk or daenet GmbH)

evals.prompt: Convert this attached DOCX into a professional scientific magazine PDF in daenet style. The article is about AI monitoring in production systems. Author: Lena Fischer. Add a contributions section at the end: Lena Fischer, Damir Dobric – prototyped at Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences.
evals.expected_output: A formatted daenet-branded two-column PDF with cover, abstract, numbered sections, and a Contributions block at the end.

assertions.name: pdf-file-created
assertions.description: A .pdf file exists in the output directory

assertions.name: contributions-present
assertions.description: The PDF contains a Contributions section

assertions.name: author-in-pdf
assertions.description: Lena Fischer appears in the PDF

assertions.name: daenet-branding
assertions.description: daenet brand text appears in the PDF
